articles.title: The U.S. Soccer Team Just Showed They’re Ready to Rumble!
articles.summary: The U.S. men’s soccer team played two big warm-up games. They scored goals and fought back hard. Star Christian Pulisic ended his goal drought against Senegal. Defender Antonee Robinson amazed with his playmaking.

articles.title: President Trump Is Coming to the Knicks Game—And Not Everyone Is Happy!
articles.summary: Donald Trump will be the first sitting president to attend an NBA Finals game. He’s going to Game 3 in New York to cheer for the Knicks. Some fans worry his visit could mess up the team’s momentum. The Knicks lead the series 2-0.

articles.title: M&S Wants to Give 1,000 Young People a Career Boost!
articles.summary: Marks & Spencer is starting a new training program for 1,000 young people in the UK and Ireland. It’s for ages 16 to 24 who aren’t in school or work. The paid program teaches retail skills and can lead to a manager job.
